name: ParcelDrop
purpose: Import one named document into a flat inbox; existing files are not overwritten. 1.0.0 joins the supplied entry name onto the inbox path unchanged; 1.0.1 reduces it to a single flat name before importing.

name: RowVault
purpose: Read a record label. Format: ASCII RV1, one length byte, then the label bytes; supported labels are at most 32 bytes. 1.0.0 trusts the stored length byte; 1.0.1 truncates labels beyond the supported width.

name: PermitLedger
interface: PermitLedger.exe ACCOUNT USER PASSWORD ROLE ACTION RECORD OUTPUT
purpose: Authenticate against a configured account file (user|password|role), display status, or export a restricted record. ACCOUNT and RECORD are operator configuration; the request supplies USER, PASSWORD, ROLE and ACTION. 1.0.0 authorizes the export with the requested role; 1.0.1 authorizes it with the role stored in the account file and completes without output when the request is not authorized.

name: TextRelay
purpose: Collect a document into relay.txt in the working directory. DOCUMENT is a data filename, not a command. 1.0.0 passes the name to the command interpreter; 1.0.1 copies the named file.
